meta.title: 索尼A6700封神的4个功能🔥90%的人没解锁

scenes.context: 很多人拿到索尼A6700只用基础拍照录像功能，不知道这台半画幅旗舰机藏着多个进阶玩法。
sentences: Most people only use the basics.
藏着提升效率的进阶玩法。
paraphrase: Most people only use the basics.
scenes.speak: Most people only use the basics. It hides powerful advanced features.

scenes.context: 对焦包围拍摄可以自动拍多张不同焦点的照片，后期导入PS一键堆叠，拍微距风光全清晰。
sentences: It shoots multiple focus distances automatically.
Stack them later for full sharpness.
paraphrase: It shoots multiple focus distances automatically.
Stack them later for full sharpness.
scenes.speak: It shoots multiple focus distances automatically. Stack them later for full sharpness.

scenes.context: 菜单里进入拍摄页找到拍摄模式选对焦包围，增量到4，拍摄张数从9张开始练手。
sentences: Pick focus bracketing in the menu.
paraphrase: Pick focus bracketing in the menu.
scenes.speak: Pick focus bracketing in the menu. Step 4, starting with 9 shots.

scenes.context: 把常用功能分配到快捷键，三套MR参数一键切换，拍照片视频不耽误。
sentences: 把常用功能分配到快捷键。
Assign frequent features to custom keys.
paraphrase: Assign frequent features to custom keys.
scenes.speak: Assign frequent features to custom keys. Switch among three setups instantly.

scenes.context: 在操作自定义中把C1设为对焦模式切换、C2设为对焦区域切换，再存储三套场景参数。
scenes.speak: C1 toggles focus mode. Store three common setups.

scenes.context: 峰值对焦让手动对焦也能精准到睫毛，大光圈拍摄不跑焦，对焦越清晰的地方红色越多。
scenes.speak: Peaking makes manual focus precise. In-focus edges light up red.

scenes.context: 菜单对焦页打开峰值显示，峰值水平设为高、色彩设为红色，手动对焦再也不发愁。
sentences: Set the peaking color to red.
paraphrase: Set the peaking color to red.
scenes.speak: Set peaking level to high. Set the peaking color to red.

scenes.context: 创意外观加S3 Tone，不用后期调色直出电影感画面，照片选FL、视频选PP11（S3Tone）。
sentences: Creative Looks give film-like straight-out-of-camera color.
paraphrase: Creative Looks give film-like straight-out-of-camera color.
scenes.speak: Creative Looks give film-like straight-out-of-camera color. Use PP11 S3Tone for video.

practice: Creative Looks give a film look out of camera.
pitfalls: 以为对焦包围要手动合成
机身自动拍序列后期堆叠
合理起步参数更容易成功
峰值让手动对焦可依赖
